page: Amazon Web Services r8i.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 128 virtual CPUs and 64 physical cores based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 6975P-C processors running at 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 1024.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, but offers a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the top tier for multi-core CPU execution, software compilation, and memory bandwidth. The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate workloads like low-precision matrix multiplication. In benchmark testing, the instance achieved top-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Redis SET operations at 218.29 million operations per second, and prompt processing for large language models.

From a resource density perspective, the r8i.32xlarge delivers high qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise applications. The combination of high-speed DDR5 memory and dedicated compute resources makes it highly suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, key-value stores, data-intensive ETL pipelines, and memory-intensive enterprise workloads.
